evidence.quote: Haifa Group operates through 19 subsidiaries worldwide, with production sites in Israel, France, and Canada, as well as proprietary blending facilities in Brazil and South Africa. || Haifa makes its advanced plant nutrition solutions available to growers in more than 100 countries.
